mapper.insert: insert into audit_log (user_id, username, action, schema_name, table_name, sql_text, success, message, elapsed_ms, ip, created_at) values (#{userId}, #{username}, #{action}, #{schemaName}, #{tableName}, #{sqlText}, #{success}, #{message}, #{elapsedMs}, #{ip}, now())
mapper.select: select * from audit_log order by id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
